newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sets April interest rate at 1.58 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sets April interest rate at 1.58 pct.

text.p: The Monetary Policy Committee said it cut the Central Bank's monthly basic interest rate, known as the TBC, to 1.58 percent in April from 1.62 percent in March.
The cut is consistent with current interest rate policy, which has seen monthly reductions of four basis points since October 1996.

The Monetary Policy Committee also set April's Basic Assistance Rate, TBAN, at 1.78 percent, down from 1.80 percent in March. The TBAN is applied to financial institutions that draw more than their limit from Central Bank credit lines.
The TBC and the TBAN roughly act as floor and ceiling, respectively, for market interest rates in Brazil.
